question: How far does the expansion of the Lord's universal wheel extend?
premises: The wheel can be described as thousand-spoked.
It can also be uncountably spoked.
The great Lord expands there as universal power.
inference: Bhairava's manifestation in wheels is not limited to fixed numbers but expands boundlessly as universal power.
plain_english: Thus, in the wheel of the universe—whether thousand-spoked or even uncountably spoked—the Lord, the great sovereign whose power is the universe, expands.
